changelog:
• Update information now comes from the public IniHub feed and is stored in English as the single source text.
• Release notes, maintenance notices and news are translated automatically when displayed, using the language selected in the Workshop translator and the same Google/MyMemory fallback approach used by the IDE.
• Workshop + IniHub metadata validation and tracked-item update detection are integrated with the public IniHub data source.
• Workshop app links and share/open handling remain connected to the public Workshop gateway for reliable opening of shared items.
